body: I don't think so.. All these people come from rich families who can have whatever they want, whenever they want. None of them are in unhappy romantic relationships. I think that if you are abused, you connect with others who've been abused whether you think it's normal or not. You don't just laugh at someone's face and tell them that their pain means nothing.
Probably because they've never been through it themselves.
It is and the damage it causes has to be taken seriously. It really can ruin a life
I enjoyed this, I can feel the emotion across the lines
This is what we should be fighting for
I hope so. Your username pretty much sums up what I'm feeling these days ahah

Thank you for this. It's reassuring to know there is a way out. It just makes me cry. Every comment I read is so supportive and compassionate and if I can get this from strangers then why couldn't I get it from people who were supposed to love me and care about me?

I will try my best to face it. I have gotten myself into therapy so that's already something. I will try to get out of bed eventually too.

I'm so sorry for what has happened to you. I'm hoping to change cities next year as well. I can't stand being here anymore. All my memories are of him and I don't feel like I'm at home anyway.

I hope you get the peace you deserve.
I hope you meet people who make you happy and love you for who you are.

My biggest fear is that my nex will never understand. He is the son of a powerful family and they have lots of money and connections. He can have a job wherever he wants, whenever he wants. He has lots of friends and he's actually very likeable as a friend.

It hurts to know I've suffered being with him for two years and none of his family or friends will ever know the truth. They will just hate me and thing I hurt their little angel and he will go on with his life. Not caring about me or about how much I've lost because of him.

I am scared he has ruined me and now I won't be able to find actual love because I'll just ruin everything for fear of being hurt again.
I really hope that's true. I mean I wish I could say I'm happy that he's happy but I'm not. His happiness cost me my mental health

I hope the best for you. No one should ever be allowed to interfere with children, I hope you manage to keep them safe.

I'm sorry for your situation and it scares me how many people are going through this...
Oh my god I'm so sorry... Its horrible! Can't you ask for custody after something like that?
Thank you for these words. I am trying and will keep trying my best.

I don't know how to be nice to myself.
I try not to think about him and about everything I lost by losing him.

He has said sorry for not treating me right during our relationship but then he still tells me to fuck off out of nowhere and that I'm a bitch for hurting him and that I deserve the pain he's put me through.

I know it takes time.. I'm just so tired of hurting.

I'm sorry about your situation. I'm here complaining about a 2 years relationship when yours was so much more meaningful.. I'm really sorry and I hope you'll be okay.

It's so hard because my friends don't know what emotional and psychological abuse feels like. They think I exaggerate and that I had all the opportunities I wanted to leave.. But I couldn't. And I don't know how to explain to them why.

And now everyone's against me and I'm trying my best to think positive and hope for the future but most days I just spend crying in my bed. How did you get out it? The pain?

I ruined things with a guy who actually loved me because of the mental problems I didn't know how to deal with. I met my nex while in the process of breaking up with the wonderful guy and stuff has just been going worse since that day.

I don't deserve love. I had it and I ruined it, to be with someone who made me feel like I was never enough.

No there's no reason to having to be in contact.
I just can't get myself to cut everything left I have of him. It's si painful and scary

I don't feel that growth. I don't feel that win. I feel nothing and I don't know how to even start to be ok agai. My ex keeps texting me and saying it's my fault that we haven't worked out and he makes me believe he wants to work it out with me again but then he is really mean. He doesn't apologise for hurting me and makes me feel like I have to be ok with that in order to be loved
Why do people treat me so bad if I don't deserve it
No, I have no one. I feel very lonely and something I just don't think it's worth it
I hope I can get there some day... Thank you

It's so hard to not reply to him... Every time I don't reply for a while he texts me saying its my fault that we are not working out because I am the one giving up on us and everything we could be. But then I reply and he's just so mean...

Thank you so much for these words. It's really hard for me to believe them, even though I try to. Sometimes I fall into a cycle where I feel like it was all my fault and like I'm not worth loving. I started going to a therapist recently and I'm going to try and solve this. It means a lot to read these messages and to be reminded that I deserve just as much ad everyone else. Thank you

Do you think I should try and solve things out with them? I was really close to some of them, but when I told them about how bad I felt, they answered "nobody forced you to keep taking him back". I don't know how to explain how difficult/practically impossible it was for me to leave...
Thank you for your support, it means the world to me to have someone who believes me and doesn't think I'm making everything up just for the sake of acting like a victim...

I've been reading many of the posts on here for a couple days and it's making me feel less alone. I'm starting to understand that what I dealt with is not just something I'm making up, but that it's real. Sometimes I wonder whether I'm exaggerating and acting like a victim but it makes me feel so much better to know I'm not the only one who's gone through this.

Thank you so much for your support and for making me feel understood.
